description: List the canonical engineering questions Balford's knowledge base is built around, grouped by process family, with the URL of the answer page for each. Use this to find the right published answer before asking a free-form question, or to see whether a topic is covered at all. Costs no model tokens.

category.description: Optional. Return only one process family, matched case-insensitively against the family title (e.g. 'fine blanking', 'deep drawing'). Omit to return every family.

name: list_engineering_topics

total.description: Number of published canonical questions returned.

title: List the questions Balford has published answers for
